https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-0.name: PsychiatryBench
https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-0.dataSource: Psychiatric casebooks, diagnostic manuals, and specialized clinical guides (DSM-5-TR Clinical Cases, Stahl's Essential Psychopharmacology, 100 Cases in Psychiatry, etc.) manually curated by licensed psychiatrists into 5,188 QA items.
https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-0.groundTruth: Expert-annotated answers based on the reference text.
https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-0.evaluation: Automated grading for closed-form tasks (MCQ / EMI / classification); an LLM-as-judge framework (LLaMA 3.3 70B) scores open-ended answers 0-100 for content similarity to the reference answer.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.08584.name: CounselBench-Eval
https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.08584.dataSource: 100 real patient questions from the CounselChat forum spanning 20 common mental-health topics.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.08584.groundTruth: Top-upvoted therapist replies serve as a human baseline compared alongside the LLMs.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.08584.evaluation: 100 licensed mental-health professionals rate each response across 6 clinical dimensions.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.08584.name: CounselBench-Adv
https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.08584.dataSource: 120 adversarial questions generated by clinicians, designed to elicit failure modes observed in CounselBench-Eval.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.08584.groundTruth: Clear clinician-authored definitions and one in-context example per failure type.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.08584.evaluation: 5 mental-health professionals (separate from the question authors) label each response for the targeted failure.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09189.name: Mental Health QA - USMLE-mental
https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09189.dataSource: 727 mental-health MCQs extracted from MedQA (USMLE Steps 1-2), keyword-filtered then author-reviewed.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09189.groundTruth: MCQ answer key based on MedQA.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09189.evaluation: Automated accuracy against the MCQ key.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09189.name: Mental Health QA - Crisis Response QA
https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09189.dataSource: 153 items authored from IACP (2018) and NAMI (2018) crisis manuals; GPT-4 created incorrect answers and medical students reviewed each question.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09189.groundTruth: MCQ key based on the reference manuals (human-verified).
https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09189.evaluation: Automated accuracy against the MCQ key.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09189.population: People in mental-health crisis (from crisis manuals).

https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09189.name: Diagnosis Prediction - Online Text (SMHD)
https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09189.dataSource: SMHD: Reddit posts from users with one or more diagnosed mental-health conditions plus matched controls; the 16 most relevant posts per user are retained; 500 users sampled (single- and multi-label).
https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09189.groundTruth: Diagnoses associated with each SMHD user (multi-label).
https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09189.evaluation: Automated classification accuracy against the diagnostic labels for each user.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09189.population: Reddit users with self-reported mental-health diagnoses and matched controls.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09189.name: Diagnosis Prediction - Dialogue (D4)
https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09189.dataSource: D4: about 130 multi-turn doctor-patient dialogues annotated with depression-risk and suicide-risk scores by clinicians.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09189.groundTruth: Clinician-assigned depression-risk and suicide-risk scores (0-3) per dialogue.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09189.evaluation: Automated accuracy against the clinician-assigned risk scores.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09189.name: Psychological Counseling (PsyQA)
https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09189.dataSource: PsyQA: Chinese online mental-health Q&A written by trained counselors/volunteers; 100 patient inquiries sampled, each paired with a support-strategy sequence.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09189.groundTruth: Professional counselor responses serve as a human baseline alongside rubric-based empathy and safety ratings.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.09189.evaluation: GPT-4 as judge for response quality and EPITOME empathy (validated against human ratings); 8 human raters on a subset; fine-tuned BERT for dialogue safety.
